ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends Customer's access after an undefined transition period with no exit obligations, so we have added a 10.3 giving up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. If helpful, we can fall back to 90 days' assistance with the same 30-day export.
proposal.summary: Insert new 10.3 requiring transition assistance, 30-day data return and certified deletion.

mappings.element: Transition assistance for up to 6 months.
